addr: 8 and 9, 7th Cross Rd, Old Madiwala, Jay Bheema Nagar, 1st Stage, BTM 1st Stage, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560068, India

rev.t: I stayed at this PG for around 10 months, paying ₹13,000 per month, and honestly, the experience was very disappointing. The management and overall service were far below what was promised. …

The stay was comfortable and well-maintained. The rooms were clean, the facilities were good, and the atmosphere was peaceful for students. The management was supportive and responsive whenever needed. Overall, it was a good experience staying here during my college years

I would have loved the stay unless if it was the response of the management to issues that were there. There were several complaints in my room which I had to continuously notify them for several months and they just kept delaying it. And …
